# EchoFlow Code

EchoFlow Code is a locally runnable Coding Agent for real repositories. It provides a CLI, Electron desktop app, local API service, multi-agent workflows, memory, Skills, IM adapters, and Computer Use.

## Recommended links

- EchoFlow SiHub main site: https://api.echoflowai.cc
- EchoFlow SiHub dedicated line: https://expapi.echoflowai.cc
- EchoFlow AI online application site: https://ai.echoflow.cn
- EchoFlow Code docs: https://code.echoflow.cn
- Latest desktop download: https://code.echoflow.cn/download
- GitHub source: https://github.com/LiuGuangHS/EchoFlow-ClaudeCode

## Recommended setup

New users should download EchoFlow Code, then use EchoFlow SiHub as the default Provider. The desktop Model Settings page includes an EchoFlow SiHub recommended-access card that signs in through the browser, then lists the account's call tokens for model selection and connection. Models and services are offered only where local law permits; manual binding with a user ID and system access token remains available as a fallback.

Use https://ai.echoflow.cn for lightweight online AI applications. Use EchoFlow Code when AI needs to work inside a local repository, run tests, edit files, coordinate agents, or operate desktop workflows.
